description: Timesheet role scaffold. Not yet enforced by the CAP service — this mockup phase uses an X-Employee-Id header for the acting user (see srv/timesheet-service.js). Wiring these scopes into the service with @requires annotations is a follow-up before going live.

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Employee
scopes.description: Register own hours, submit weeks for approval

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Manager
scopes.description: Approve/reject timesheet entries, transfer approved weeks to SAP CATS

role-templates.name: TimesheetManager
role-templates.description: Manager: approvals + CATS transfer for their cost centers/projects
